No synthetic pressure promoted to structural/causal N9/FF assertions.

Exact source opens ≤1 native source decode for one verified producer, no second whole-C11 body or undocumented extra physical estate. **G4** produce measured small + mid sourcefree exact physical disk/stage highwater, process-tree RSS (parent and children), object reconstructions/family yields across actual routes, cold/repeated latency and crash/restart; later [scale gate issue] separate 100k respondents/6GiB.
